name: Barbara A. Hart
tagline: Top rated Bankruptcy attorney in Tampa, Florida
about: Barbara A. Hart is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Tampa, Florida area. Providing legal representation in Florida for a variety of different issues, Barbara Hart was selected to Super Lawyers for 2015 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Barbara A. Hart attended law school. Barbara Hart was enrolled at Stetson University College of Law. She earned a juris doctor degree in 2001. Barbara Hart was admitted to the practice of law in 2001.

Attorneys like Barbara A. Hart are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.

Barbara Hart represents clients with Bankruptcy: Business issues. Additional legal issues represented include Creditor Debtor Rights: Business, Appellate, Civil Litigation: Defense and Business Litigation.
